abrUsers.bootstrapDdl: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS abr_users (id text PRIMARY KEY, org_id text NOT NULL, role text NOT NULL, email text NOT NULL, name text NOT NULL, active boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
liveColumns: active boolean not null default true
created_at timestamptz not null default now()
abrUsers.whyItWasAbsentEarlier: The table is bootstrap-created on demand by ABR service startup paths; until those code paths execute against a local database, the table does not exist.

membershipResolver.lookupShape: select role, active from abr_users where id = $userId and org_id = $orgId limit 1
